symptom: Retry-violation detection counted NEW_FAILURE records across a later VERIFIED_SUCCESS, so two pre-success failures plus one post-success failure could be misclassified as a prohibited third unchanged attempt.
lesson: Retry-violation auditing must use the same decisive-learning epochs as gate evaluation: a matching reusable VERIFIED_SUCCESS starts a new failure-count epoch, while observational records do not.
guardrail: Group by the full normalized identity and count consecutive NEW_FAILURE records within each decisive epoch; reset the counter only at a matching VERIFIED_SUCCESS with REUSE_VERIFIED_GUARDRAIL.
